messages:
maya: Heads-up, Nimbus reported p99 tripling on chat/generate after last runtime push.
infra-bot: Deployed runtime-gpu v4.8 -> v4.9 @ 2024-08-21T03:12:08Z (flags: FLASHATTN=enabled, SDPA=enabled, KERNEL_SELECTION=v3)
rishi: Any 5xx/errors? route?
maya: No errors. chat/generate sync calls. p95 ~ +12%, p99 ~x2.8. Flame shows attention kernel time increase for long sequences (2k-6k tokens).
tom: Repro locally with perf-replay and mixed seqs. With SDPA on p99 ~1.9s; SDPA off p99 ~650ms.
canary-bot: Replay command: ./replay --route chat/generate --model chat-v2 --seqs 256,1024,2048,3072 --rps 25 --profile kernels
rishi: If SDPA path adds transforms for skewed batches it can cost us. Any kernel-selection heuristic changes recently?
infra-bot: Feature flag change: sdpa_aggressive=true rolled in runtime v4.9 by deploy-bot @ 2024-08-21T03:10:00Z
maya: Root cause: heuristic uses token_estimate that doesn't include prefix tokenization when prefix-caching enabled -> underestimates by ~20-40%, misrouting many long requests into SDPA.
tom: SDPA internal memcpy + packed-KV layout overhead dominates for batch_size<6 and seq>2k.
ops-oncall: Mit options: 1) global rollback SDPA 2) raise seq threshold 3) hot-fallback per shard when kernel latency bad.
maya: Prefer minimal blast radius: raise sdpa_seq_threshold from 1536 -> 4096 and add fallback if kernel_latency > 700ms for 3 samples.
infra-bot: Flag update (canary): sdpa_seq_threshold=4096 @ 2024-08-21T03:23:12Z by tom
canary-bot: Canary metrics: p99 dropped 1.9s -> 700ms after threshold bump. p95 steady.
maya: Good. I'll notify Nimbus and open incident.
support-bot: Incident INC-2024-1182 created and linked. Customer notified: rollback plan + ETA for fix.
rishi: I'll patch estimator to account for prefix tokenization and add unit tests. PR target: 24h.
tom: I'll implement per-shard hysteresis fallback: if kernel path exceeds 700ms for 3 consecutive samples, switch shard to fallback kernel for 10m and emit alert.
ops-oncall: Rolling sdpa_seq_threshold=4096 to prod now.
infra-bot: Flag update (global): sdpa_seq_threshold=4096 @ 2024-08-21T03:36:40Z by tom
maya: Post-incident actions:
- rishi: fix estimator + tests (due 2024-08-22)
- tom: implement fallback hysteresis + tracing (due 2024-08-23)
- maya: runbook for sdpa rollouts with seq-histogram gating (due 2024-08-24)
ops-oncall: We'll keep incident open for 48h monitoring. Thanks.
maya: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
